<includeonly>{{#invoke:Erenshor/Icon|main}}</includeonly><noinclude>
== Template:Icon ==
Draws a native icon texture in its frame: items in a slot with a blue gradient ring, spells, skills, and stances in a black border. Artwork keeps its proportions inside the square; transparent margins remain visible. Use this for icons, not large infobox pictures.

=== Parameters ===
{| class="wikitable"
! Parameter !! Required !! Description
|-
| <code>1</code> || Yes || File title including its extension, without <code>File:</code>.
|-
| <code>kind</code> || Yes || <code>item</code>: a slot with a blue gradient ring and a dark well behind the icon. <code>ability</code>: a black border around a spell, skill, or stance icon.
|-
| <code>size</code> || Yes || Positive integer side length in pixels, without <code>px</code>.
|-
| <code>link</code> || No || Page title to open. An explicitly empty value disables the link; omission opens the file page.
|-
| <code>alt</code> || No || Alternative text for the artwork.
|}

<pre>{{Icon|Thorned Branch icon.png|kind=item|size=80|link=Thorned Branch|alt=Thorned Branch}}</pre>
<pre>{{Icon|Florablast icon.png|kind=ability|size=24|link=Florablast}}</pre>

Lua callers use <code>Icon.render(frame, { file = "Thorned Branch icon.png", kind = "item", size = 80, link = "Thorned Branch" })</code> from [[Module:Erenshor/Icon]]. The module loads [[Template:Icon/styles.css]] once per page through TemplateStyles. Missing files, unknown kinds, and invalid sizes are script errors.
</noinclude>
